name: TG-GithubBot
description: Telegram bot that connects GitHub repositories to Telegram chats: notifications for pushes, issues, PRs, and more, with OAuth login and reply actions.

TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL of this app (no trailing slash), e.g. https://your-app.herokuapp.com

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID of your GitHub OAuth App

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of your GitHub OAuth App

GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Random string used to validate GitHub webhook payloads (openssl rand -hex 20)

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: 64 hex chars (32 bytes) used to encrypt stored OAuth tokens (openssl rand -hex 32)

MONGODB_URI.description: External MongoDB connection string (e.g. MongoDB Atlas)

USE_POLLING.description: Set to true to use Telegram long-polling instead of webhooks (recommended on Heroku)
